payload.body: Implemented agent-native coordination without a Scope runner or UI dependency: conflict-aware parallel plans, derived lifecycle, agent-readable execution projections, observed repository intent, and durable structured handoffs across CLI/Node/REST/MCP. Removed dispatch/prompt/provider abstractions and taught packaged skills to use host-native Codex/Claude orchestration. Verified 401 tests: 331 pass, 70 PostgreSQL-only skips, 0 failures.
